prompt: Toggle WLAST to appear one beat early in the burst. Explain why this is a protocol violation and what a real scoreboard would flag.
expectedTakeaway: Toggling WLAST early causes a FAIL (Protocol Violation). AXI requires WLAST to align perfectly with the final data beat derived from AWLEN. If it arrives early, a slave might prematurely terminate the write operation, leaving subsequent beats orphaned or causing state machines to desync. A real scoreboard would flag this as a premature burst termination.
